prompted_for: Header of a hub page that lists one area (became Hero on hub and company pages: numbered index of the pages inside the area, joined by a routed line)
composition: split hero: oversized multi-line headline left, numbered index list right
top nav bar with wordmark, four links and an outlined button
body paragraph, two buttons and a row of standard tags stacked under the headline
mobile column to the right stacking headline, tags, CTA and the index
small viewport labels above each view
layout_devices: thin routed vertical line with dot nodes linking the index items
dashed connector lines and small arrows between items
dot-grid patches and registration crosses as schematic noise
corner brackets on the hero frame
mobile timeline rail with a thicker active segment
palette: deep navy for headline, numerals and rules
steel-blue filled primary button and rail nodes
grey hairline frames and dotted textures
typography: heavy condensed sans caps headline, tight leading
small mono caps for tags and viewport labels
rendering: UI mockup with no device frame
motifs: standards chips (USP, Ph. Eur., GMP, ASME BPE)
valve-like small squares on the route
motion_implied: route line draws down through the index
t2i_keywords: thin routed vertical line with dot nodes
t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup, no device frame, of a hub page header for <CONTENT>. Warm off-white limestone background, deep navy type and hairlines, a single steel-blue primary button. Left: an oversized bold condensed uppercase headline, a short paragraph, two square buttons and outlined tag chips. Right: a numbered index of sub-pages with large mono numerals, joined by a thin routed vertical line with dot nodes, dashed connectors, small arrows and a rotated vertical label. Faint dot-grid patches and registration crosses. A narrow phone view beside it stacks everything on a vertical rail. Flat vector, square corners, no shadows, generous negative space.
signature_idea: A hub page's contents become the hero itself: a numbered index of its pages strung on one routed pipe-like line.
strengths: immediately tells an engineer what is in the area and where to go
numbered route is a strong, reusable navigation device
standards chips put compliance up front
mobile translation as a rail is clean
weaknesses: headline in heavy condensed caps is shouty and off the Geist-light voice
schematic noise (dot patches, stray arrows) is decorative clutter
big all-caps headline is long and hard to read
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy, one steel-blue accent and square corners are on brand; heavy condensed caps headline contradicts Geist light headlines.
